branch_hygiene.policy: Delete merged service/development branches and fully absorbed temporary branches after each coherent cycle. A preserved-prefix branch may be deleted only after its exact head is reachable from main, a release tag, or a protected provenance tag. Never delete the sole Git ref that preserves candidate, gate, framework, Manager-release, rejection, or qualification provenance. Never rewrite main or published release history for cleanup.

ci_concurrency.source_validation_policy: windows-powershell.yml may cancel obsolete pull-request runs, but top-level concurrency and the scope detector itself are excluded from disposable Manager Full Gate qualification scope. The detector hashes Manager managed bytes, the disposable Full Gate runner, and the qualification-execution region beginning at 'Verify candidate public boundary and Actions policy'. Qualification-execution changes without a Manager version transition fail closed unless an explicit workflow_dispatch baseline is supplied.
ci_concurrency.policy: Obsolete PR runs may be cancelled only for workflows listed in pr_cancel_workflows. Push/main validation and publication runs are immutable evidence for a specific main SHA and must not be cancelled merely because a newer push starts.

runner_labels.policy: Use explicit GA OS-family labels for GitHub-hosted runners. Image patch/build revisions may still advance within the pinned OS family.

manager_release_publication_requires: native GitHub immutable release for every non-legacy tag
valid GitHub release attestation for every non-legacy tag

future_provenance.policy: For future Manager releases, record the exact pre-provenance product-source commit that was qualified. Never attempt to record the SHA of a commit inside that same commit; final publication identity remains a separate Git/release identity.

conditional_pr_gate.behavior: Every PR gets release-policy. Non-release diffs pass immediately; release-critical diffs require distribution-gate success on the exact PR head SHA. Release-critical classification is read from this policy rather than duplicated in release-policy executable logic.

immutable_releases.legacy_policy: Legacy mutable tags are historical exceptions only. They must already exist, their tag targets and complete asset sets must match LEGACY_RELEASE_BASELINE.json exactly, and the publisher must never recreate or rewrite them.
